messages:
violet (People Ops): Quick pulse check  I'm assembling a tiny 'mid-cycle course-correction' kit for managers: one priority ladder, a 3-line manager action checklist, and paste-ready starters for coaching conversations. Want it to be usable in a 5-min sync. Feedback welcome.

eli (Eng Manager): Love the focus on mid-cycle. Can we make it explicit how to convert a stretched goal into a learning ticket rather than dropping it?

violet (People Ops): Yes. Draft below. Keep replies short.

```
MID-CYCLE COURSE-CORRECTION KIT (paste-ready)

Priority ladder (3 tiers, one-line each):
- COMMITTED: Ship this quarter. Clear owner, measurable signal, testable slice.
- SUPPORTING: Helps a committed goal or unblocks other teams; lower scope.
- LEARNING: Invest for capability / skill growth; no metric requirement this quarter.

Manager action checklist (3 items, drop into 1:1):
1) Re-assess impact vs cost: "Which committed item still moves the needle if we only finish one?"
2) Re-scope into a testable slice: "What's the smallest experiment that proves value?" (assign owner + week target)
3) Reclassify & document: If not commit-worthy, move to SUPPORTING or LEARNING and note tradeoff in the team board.

How to convert a STRETCH into LEARNING (paste):
- Keep a 2-sentence learning objective + one experiment: e.g. "Goal: evaluate async kernels to reduce p95. Experiment: run gated canary on 10% traffic for 2 weeks; success = p95 < 360ms." Tag as LEARNING and remove hard metric from quarter commits.

Paste-ready manager coaching starters (single lines):
- "If you had six more hours, which part would you tackle first to prove this idea?" 
- "Tell me the riskiest assumption here; how would you test it in one sprint?" 
- "If this stalls, what do you want me to deprioritize for the team?"

Micro self-review template (3 lines, IC paste):
- Outcome: one-sentence result or experiment + metric/signal (or adoption signal if non-metric).
- My role: 1-2 bullets of ownership.
- Next ask: one-line request + tag e.g. [HC-PENDING] / [INF-PENDING] / [LEARN-TRACK]

One-line skip-level summary (paste for managers to send up):
- "Team: search infra; Outcome: MVP cache migration shipped; Status: SUPPORTING -> METRIC lag 2w; HC: [HC-PENDING] 1 SWE to reduce on-call and speed final validation." 

Peer kudos 30s (async line to include in reviews):
- "Kudos: Ran the canary plan and caught a config bug before rollout; saved ~3 hours of incidents." 

Quick scanning tags (add after lines):
- MET / SUPPORTING / LEARNING / HC-PENDING / INF-PENDING / LEARN-TRACK

Privacy check (one-liner to paste when relevant):
- "If this work uses customer data, confirm retention & DSR steps w/ security before canary." 

Naming hint for tickets/goals (one-liner):
- "<team>.<short-goal>.<quarter> e.g. infra.cache-migrate.q3" 

```

sam (SWE): Nice. The convert-to-learning section is clutch. Would add an explicit owner + deadline on the experiment line so it doesn't stall.

andrea (Director, Product): Great. Also add a one-line note managers can paste for product tradeoffs: "Reason: deprioritized due to customer signal X; recommend revisit next cycle if metric changes."

eli (Eng Manager): Minor edit: change tag [HC-PENDING] -> [HC-REQ] so recruiting picks it up automatically.

violet (People Ops): Good catch @eli. I'll standardize tags to match other templates: [HC-REQ] / [INF-REQ] / [LEARN-TRACK]. Adding owner+deadline to experiment line and Andrea's tradeoff sentence. Will publish to templates and pin in #people-ops. ETA EOD.

ops-bot: Template saved: https://redwood.internal/templates/midcycle-course-correction-v1 (auto) :white_check_mark:

andrea (Director, Product): Thanks  will ask managers to use this in next week's sync and include a 5-min slot for reclassification.

sam (SWE): Thx  will try it in my 1:1 tomorrow.

violet (People Ops): Appreciate the quick reviews! Final version will include an example per tier and a tiny GIF showing paste flow.
